_doc: The layered network's simulator directives for an inverter (research/layered-networks at a308eec: instrument.deck_text = deck.build at calibration.json design_point: reltol 1e-5 on the .option line, vhi 0.7 on the .param line; junction areas for R cells only, inverter devices at zero area, which is the PDK subcircuits' own default ad = as = pd = ps = 0). Taken verbatim from the deck of specs/not1.json; tests/test_netopts.py checks them against that branch. Used by invinst/netdeck.py and invinst/driver2.py; config.json and cell.py stay as pushed.
